instruction: Generate Grafana API token via ENV for provisioning
Use Grafana API with service account token
Get Grafana datasource ID by UID via API
Check if Grafana datasource exists via API
Bulk create dashboards from directory via API
output: for f in /dashboards/*.json; do curl -X POST http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/dashboards/db -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"dashboard\":$(cat $f),\"overwrite\":true}"; done

instruction: Delete expired Grafana snapshots via API
output: curl -s http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/snapshots | jq -r '.[].key' | while read key; do curl -X DELETE "http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/snapshots/$key"; done

instruction: Get Grafana dashboard list with UIDs and titles
Clone a Grafana dashboard by UID
output: curl -s http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/dashboards/uid/abc | jq '.dashboard + {"title": "Clone of Dashboard"}' | curl -X POST http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/dashboards/db -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @-

curl -s http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/search?type=dash-db | jq -r '.[].uid' | while read uid; do curl -s http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/dashboards/uid/$uid | jq '.dashboard' > "${uid}.json"; done

for f in *.json; do uid=$(jq -r '.uid' $f); curl -X POST http://admin:admin@localhost:3000/api/dashboards/db -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"dashboard\":$(cat $f),\"overwrite\":true,\"message\":\"imported\"}"; done

instruction: Get Grafana org creation date via API
Restrict Grafana dashboard access by IP
output: echo '[auth.proxy] enabled = true header_name = X-EMAIL header_property = email' >> /etc/grafana/grafana.ini

instruction: Set Grafana max dashboard import size
Configure Grafana custom auth proxy header
output: echo '[auth.proxy] enabled = true header_name = X-WEBAUTH-USER auto_sign_up = true' >> /etc/grafana/grafana.ini

echo '[auth.generic_oauth] enabled = true client_id = oidc_client client_secret = secret scopes = openid,profile,email auth_url = https://idp.example.com/auth token_url = https://idp.example.com/token api_url = https://idp.example.com/userinfo' >> /etc/grafana/grafana.ini
